name: Fleet & vehicle telematics
source: Vendor names common in Australian fleets. Name-matched to avoid OUI false positives; these devices are mostly cellular and may not advertise over BLE/Wi-Fi unless in pairing mode.

rules.label: Fleet telematics unit
rules.note: Telematics/GPS tracking units common in Australian commercial fleets (EROAD, Teletrac Navman, Cartrack, Smartrak, Geotab, Samsara).
